streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

actual_frame_order_negative_controls.scope: Actual decoded-frame reassignment in memory; no video alteration/encoding. Strong central sequence shifts, not a claim to distinguish arbitrarily near-identical images.

limits: Exact recipe/PNG/96 PTS provenance, strict full decode and same-index compression checks. Local +/-2 source correspondence tested; raw RGB ambiguity retained and independently resolved with multiscale luma where possible. This supports intended order with PTS and encoder-input provenance, not mathematical source-order certification. Lossy duplicates are reported, not equated with fabrication. Adjacent statistics flag review candidates, not temporal-flicker or global visual certification.
